label: iris-cli
description: iris's native CLI with intelligent routing, sandbox workflow, and cross-repo context. Full agent orchestration with safety gates, review loops, and persistent memory.
_note: iris-cli command integration updated (uses 'iris chat' as of March 2026)
installCmd: cd ~/Iris/iris-cli && npm install && npm run build
notes: iris-cli is iris's native execution engine. Unlike external CLIs (OpenCode, Cursor), it has direct access to the full agent roster, shared memory, and gateway routing. Use for complex multi-agent tasks, planning, and orchestration.
